description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill mappings are attached to sections. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in the batch, not that the section has no mechanic. Null page_tags means the batch did not record a page-level tag list.

sections.name: Wild Sniper
sections.description_summary: Dashes to a selected tile and fires a penetrative bolt along a 1-tile-wide path, damaging and stunning enemies. At LV 3, hits trigger Scorching Gift explosions at the target location.

sections.name: Sweet Encounter
sections.description_summary: Whip attack knocks an enemy back and immobilizes them. If another enemy is behind the target, knocks the target into them and immobilizes both; collision damage is based on the other enemy's ATK.

sections.name: Scorching Gift
sections.description_summary: Fires an explosive bolt that damages the target and adjacent enemies; higher levels expand explosion range.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; damaging three different enemies within 3 seconds grants additional Haste.

sections.name: Sleight of Hand
sections.description_summary: Sweet Encounter can be cast twice at battle start on different targets and gains bonus damage. Higher level temporarily steals ATK and Phys DEF.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Restores 10% max HP whenever an enemy is directly hit by Wild Sniper. LV 2 grants unaffected and Haste during Sweet Encounter; if the target collides with another enemy, both lose Phys DEF temporarily.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit; critical hits cause splash damage to nearby enemies. Higher ranks convert some critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks stack ATK SPD and normal attack damage; refine adds Crit and Haste.

sections.name: Futile Echo
sections.description_summary: Sacrifices 12% max HP to summon an identical Illusion during preparation. The Illusion inherits all stats and can cast all skills. If they share a row, both gain damage reduction until one is defeated. Active cast damages nearby enemies and heals Phraesto for each enemy hit.

sections.name: Crimson Contract
sections.description_summary: Phraesto and Illusion sign permanent contracts with different allies one tile behind them. Phraesto's contract increases Energy Recovery Speed; Illusion's reduces damage taken. Active cast performs three strikes against an enemy in front.

sections.name: Vicious Sting
sections.description_summary: Stings an enemy, reducing Haste and Vitality and applying Paralyzing Venom, which drains a percentage of max HP each second while healing the caster.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Phys & Magic DEF for Phraesto and Illusion; when one loses a percentage of max HP, the other gains Energy.

sections.name: Foggy Whisper
sections.description_summary: If Illusion is defeated first, Phraesto taunts the enemy who dealt most damage, damages and stuns them. Higher level can summon a replacement Illusion once per battle.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Same-row opening condition grants Phraesto and Illusion shields.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Periodically increases ATK and Life Drain of nearby allies; higher ranks grant Phraesto a shield per ally affected.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Below 60% HP, reduces damage taken and restores lost HP over 8 seconds, up to once every 20 seconds; refine adds Vitality and Ranged DEF.

sections.name: Soul Retaliation
sections.description_summary: Charges briefly, then slashes enemies; damage includes a percentage of damage received during the charge. Gains Life Drain and is unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Soul Plunder
sections.description_summary: Targets the enemy with highest HP not already affected, drains a portion of current HP to increase Thoran's max HP and makes the target take increased damage for the rest of battle. Drained HP is capped by Thoran's ATK.

sections.name: Resurrection
sections.description_summary: After a fatal blow, Thoran resurrects after a brief delay and recovers HP; once per battle. Higher level adds Energy when triggered.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Energy Recovery from normal attacks and skills; additional Energy Recovery while Resurrection has not triggered.

sections.name: Soul Pact
sections.description_summary: Signs a pact with the ally one tile behind him and takes half their damage. On a fatal blow, the ally sacrifices part of current HP to save and heal Thoran; afterward Thoran no longer takes damage for that ally.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Soul Retaliation drains an additional portion of current HP from all enemies affected by Soul Plunder and adds the drained amount to Thoran's max HP.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Every 8 seconds increases ATK and Life Drain of allies within 2 tiles. Higher ranks grant Thoran a shield for each ally affected.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Below 60% HP, reduces damage taken and restores lost HP over 8 seconds; refine adds Crit Resist, Ranged DEF and Crit DMG DEF.

sections.name: Panic Projection
sections.description_summary: Pandora herself is protected by hope. Active cast causes all units on the battlefield to flee toward their own side for 5 seconds while losing HP periodically; afterward, their ATK is reduced for 8 seconds, stacking up to three times.

sections.name: Boxed Blessing
sections.description_summary: At battle start, pulls the rearmost ally into Pandora's box, making them invincible but unable to cast skills for 4 seconds; the ally receives HP and Energy when released.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Pandora's max HP; adds more max HP after she is corrupted by her box.

sections.name: Eternal Legacy
sections.description_summary: After Pandora is defeated, the box remains indestructible and unaffected, recovers Energy and can cast Panic Projection again without its HP-loss effect. It also casts Tainted Tribute on a random enemy every 5 seconds.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: The ally pulled into Pandora's box is permanently protected by hope and becomes immune to Panic Projection, even after Pandora is defeated.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening ranged-damage bonus to the ally one tile behind Pandora; higher ranks grant that ally a shield the first time their HP falls below 50%.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: The first ally below 40% HP is healed and shielded; refine adds Healing and Haste.

sections.name: Wild Shift
sections.description_summary: Immobilizes two rearmost enemies, teleports them to a target tile and drops them, damaging and knocking down enemies there. Each skill has a 20% chance to go out of control, teleporting its target to a random enemy-side location.

sections.name: Mad Missiles
sections.description_summary: Fires 9–12 magic missiles in quick succession; if out of control, missiles may hit random targets, including allies.

sections.name: Botanical Woe
sections.description_summary: Summons plants in the area with the most enemies, damaging enemies and reducing their Energy each second.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; after four skill casts without going out of control, grants more Haste.

sections.name: Mage's Bloom
sections.description_summary: The first cast of each skill cannot go out of control; each skill has a chance to mutate, adding area true damage and immobilization around the target.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When Wild Shift mutates, the target tile enemy is immobilized and the two teleported enemies take extra max-HP-based damage when they land.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening damage and Haste bonus for 12 seconds; higher ranks restore HP and extend the effect after assisting or defeating a non-summoned enemy.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Ultimate casts grant a temporary damage dealt bonus; the first Ultimate also permanently increases Energy recovery from attacking. Refine adds Crit and Crit DMG Boost.
